ازدريا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَيَا (izdarayā) /iz.da.ra.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# اُزْدُرِيَا (uzduriyā) /uz.du.ri.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# اِزْدَرِيَا (izdariyā) /iz.da.ri.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
